description: This file defines the abstract syntax tree (AST) node classes and related structures for parsing and representing a syntax tree in a build system or scripting language, including nodes for expressions, statements, comments, and scope management.

classes.name: Comments
classes.description: Manages comments associated with parse nodes, including comments before, suffix, and after comments.

classes.name: ParseNode
classes.description: Abstract base class for all AST nodes, providing common interface and JSON serialization.

classes.name: AccessorNode
classes.description: Represents property or array access in the AST.

classes.name: BlockNode
classes.description: Represents a block of statements, with scope management.

classes.name: EndNode
classes.description: Represents the end token of lists and blocks, allowing comments to be attached at the end.

methods.name: ParseNode::Execute
methods.description: Pure virtual method to execute the node in a given scope.

methods.name: ParseNode::GetRange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get the source range of the node.

methods.name: ParseNode::MakeErrorDescribing
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create an error describing issues with the node.

methods.name: ParseNode::GetJSONNode
methods.description: Pure virtual method to serialize the node to JSON.

methods.name: Comments::append_before
methods.description: Adds a comment token to the before comments list.

methods.name: Comments::append_suffix
methods.description: Adds a comment token to the suffix comments list.

methods.name: Comments::ReverseSuffix
methods.description: Reverses the order of suffix comments.

methods.name: Comments::append_after
methods.description: Adds a comment token to the after comments list.
